name: GetEmailById
description: Retrieves a specific email message from a mailbox using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox containing the email to retrieve.

fields.name: MessageId
fields.label: Message ID
fields.description: The unique identifier of the email message to retrieve.

fields.name: IncludeAttachments
fields.label: Include Attachments
fields.description: Whether to include email attachments in the results. If set to 'true', the response will contain attachment details and content (if applicable). If 'false', attachments will be excluded from the response.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The retrieved email message, including its properties and optionally its attachments based on the 'Include Attachments' setting.
